infos.sourceText: export const Verified = requirement({ refines: [SharedRules], rule: (sketch: GraphSketch, reach: ObligationReach, p: { kinds: readonly string[] }): ObligationFinding => ({ obliged: once(reach.reached.flatMap((r) => verifiedBy(sketch, r).map((s) => ({ node: s, via: r })))), gaps: reach.reached.filter((r) => p.kinds.includes(kindOf(sketch, r) ?? "") && verifiedBy(sketch, r).length === 0), }), })
infos.title: The code a shipment ships is verified
infos.description: Each scenario that verifies a node the shipment reaches, and each check whose program verifies one on a machine, is to prove. A reached node of the kinds named (entry points, functions…) that none of them verifies is a gap: a check made by hand is the family Checked's business, and proves nothing a machine can run.

infos.sourceText: export const Served = requirement({ refines: [SharedRules], rule: (sketch: GraphSketch, reach: ObligationReach): ObligationFinding => { const up = (from: string, seen = new Set<string>()): Set<string> => { for (const to of [...edgesFrom(sketch, from, EdgeName.serves), ...edgesFrom(sketch, from, EdgeName.refines)]) { if (seen.has(to)) continue seen.add(to) up(to, seen) } return seen } const down = (to: string, seen = new Set<string>()): Set<string> => { for (const from of edgesTo(sketch, to, EdgeName.refines)) { if (seen.has(from)) continue seen.add(from) down(from, seen) } return seen } return { obliged: once(reach.reached.flatMap((r) => { const served = [...up(r)] return [...new Set([...served, ...served.flatMap((s) => [...down(s)])])] .filter((n) => kindOf(sketch, n) === KindName.requirement) .map((n) => ({ node: n, via: r })) })), gaps: [], } }, })
infos.title: The product a shipment serves holds
infos.description: From what the shipment reaches, what it serves; from the requirements served, up through what they refine, to the goals. Every requirement that refines those goals or those requirements, at any depth, is to prove.

infos.sourceText: export const VerifiedCriteria = acceptance({ accepts: Verified, owner: "trame", criteria: (criterion) => { criterion("The scenarios verifying the reached code are to prove", () => refs(Verified(fixture, shipping, { kinds: ["entry", "function"] })) === "Home") criterion("Reached code no scenario verifies, of the kinds named, is a gap", () => Verified(fixture, shipping, { kinds: ["entry", "function"] }).gaps.join(" ") === "Draw") criterion("A check whose program verifies reached code is to prove, and closes its gap", () => { const machine = sketch([["Disk", "implementation"], ["Runs", "check"], ["Doctor", "entry"]], [["Runs", "verifies", "Disk"], ["Runs", "runs", "Doctor"]]) const found = Verified(machine, { shipped: [], reached: ["Disk"] }, { kinds: ["implementation"] }) return refs(found) === "Runs" && found.gaps.length === 0 }) criterion("A check made by hand is not to prove here, and leaves the gap", () => { const hand = sketch([["Bowl", "implementation"], ["Phone", "check"]], [["Phone", "verifies", "Bowl"]]) const found = Verified(hand, { shipped: [], reached: ["Bowl"] }, { kinds: ["implementation"] }) return refs(found) === "" && found.gaps.join(" ") === "Bowl" }) criterion("A node is to prove once, for the first reached node that brought it in", () => { const twice = sketch([["S", "scenario"], ["A", "entry"], ["B", "entry"]], [["S", "verifies", "A"], ["S", "verifies", "B"]]) const [only, ...others] = Verified(twice, { shipped: [], reached: ["A", "B"] }, { kinds: ["entry"] }).obliged return others.length === 0 && only?.via === "A" }) }, })
